summary: Who this connection acts as and what it may do: its grants and consumer APIs.
The active workspaces this connection may read, a page at a time. Pass nextCursor back as cursor to read on.
A workspace's model by key and name: its applications with their views, its record types, relation types and consumer APIs.
One record type: its attributes with their types and filters, its parents, its relationships and the views that show it. With changeSetId, as that change set's model release has it.
Records of one type matching criteria over their fields, ancestors and one relation hop. Live data, or with changeSetId that change set's. Pass nextCursor back as cursor to read on.
One record with its values and path, and a page of its relationships; with changeSetId as that change set holds it. Pass nextCursor back as cursor to read on.
The source records of a mapping view with what they map to; state=unmapped lists those without a target. describe_model names the views. Pass nextCursor back as cursor to read on.
A record's history, newest first. Pass nextCursor back as cursor to read on.

The facts of what changed in a workspace, or in one record, over a period: what the engine counted over every live change, each with where it leads. Give objectType and id for one record. since is included, until is not; the days read in timeZone (UTC without one). Pass nextCursor back as cursor to read on.
A workspace's changes, newest first; since is included, until is not. Pass nextCursor back as cursor to read on.
The open change sets this connection created, newest change first, with version and submission state. Pass nextCursor back as cursor to read on.
One of your change sets: its version, model release and submission state, with the last decision's outcome and comment, such as why it was sent back.
The records or relationships one of your change sets adds, changes or removes against live data. Pass nextCursor back as cursor to read on.
Check one of your change sets against the model's rules, as submitting does, and list what is wrong. A long list comes in parts: pass nextCursor back as cursor to read on.
Start a change set in a workspace, from its live data. Changes are prepared in it and reach live data only when a person approves it.
Add a new record to one of your change sets. It reaches live data only when a person approves the change set. Answers its ID and versions.
Change a record's name, parent or values in one of your change sets; attributes given are set, others kept. It reaches live data only when a person approves the change set.
Set one value of a record in one of your change sets, adding it or replacing it. It reaches live data only when a person approves the change set.
Relate two records in one of your change sets. It reaches live data only when a person approves the change set.
Replace the values of a relationship in one of your change sets. It reaches live data only when a person approves the change set.
Send one of your change sets to a person for approval, after checking it. It is then frozen; the change reaches live data only when a person approves it.
